noise_policy: Topic -1 is dropped and excluded from the volume denominator.

perspectives.title: Job Displacement
perspectives.summary: People are tracking layoffs and wondering which white-collar roles survive the next model release.

representative_posts.author: maya.bsky
representative_posts.text: Third agency this month replaced their junior writers with an LLM. This is not a vibe, it is a payroll strategy.

representative_posts.author: unionize.dev
representative_posts.text: If your job is 'summarize the meeting', the meeting is already the product. Automating you was the easy part.

representative_posts.author: careershelf
representative_posts.text: Career counselor today told a room of new grads to 'become AI-proof'. Nobody could define what that means.

perspectives.title: Acceleration Optimism
perspectives.summary: A loud cohort treats faster models as a civilizational upgrade and wants fewer brakes, not more.

representative_posts.author: buildfast
representative_posts.text: The productivity jump from local models this year is real. I shipped in a weekend what used to take a squad.

representative_posts.author: nova.codes
representative_posts.text: We are arguing about feelings while a billion people just got a free research assistant. Scale is the moral story.

representative_posts.author: garage-lab
representative_posts.text: Open weights are the printing press. The panic is the same genre as every other literacy panic.

perspectives.title: Safety Alignment
perspectives.summary: Researchers and bystanders keep returning to loss-of-control, evals, and whether labs will slow down.

representative_posts.author: evalwatch
representative_posts.text: Capability demos dropped. The public eval suite did not. That gap is the actual news.

representative_posts.author: redteam.bsky
representative_posts.text: I do not need sci-fi. I need labs to publish what their models will not refuse next quarter.

representative_posts.author: slowtake
representative_posts.text: Alignment is not a vibe check. If you cannot measure it, you are fundraising, not governing.

perspectives.title: Creative Labor
perspectives.summary: Artists and performers frame generative tools as unpaid training on their catalogs.

representative_posts.author: inkstudy
representative_posts.text: My style is in six commercial models and I was never asked. That is not inspiration, that is inventory.

representative_posts.author: session-musician
representative_posts.text: Labels want infinite cheap stems. They still want a human face for the encore. Guess who gets the contract.

representative_posts.author: comicgrid
representative_posts.text: Commission market is weird now. Clients send a generated rough and ask me to 'make it not look generated'.

perspectives.title: Energy Footprint
perspectives.summary: The cluster boom is being read as a climate and utilities story, not just a software story.

representative_posts.author: gridnotes
representative_posts.text: Our town's next substation is sized for a training campus, not households. That should be a public meeting.

representative_posts.author: hydro.watch
representative_posts.text: Water-cooled racks in a drought basin is the kind of sentence that used to live in a dystopian novel.

representative_posts.author: wattmeter
representative_posts.text: I want the model card to include megawatts. Tokens are not a unit of accountability.

perspectives.title: Everyday Copilots
perspectives.summary: The quieter majority is just using assistants for mail, homework, and small workarounds.

representative_posts.author: tuesday.admin
representative_posts.text: I do not care about AGI. I care that it drafted the insurance appeal I had been avoiding for six weeks.

representative_posts.author: dad-of-three
representative_posts.text: Helped my kid outline a history essay. The useful part was the questions, not the paragraphs.

representative_posts.author: clinic.front
representative_posts.text: We use it to translate after-visit notes. Imperfect, but the alternative was sending people home confused.

perspectives.title: Rent Burden
perspectives.summary: A dominant thread treats rent as the organizing fact of adult life, crowding out every other plan.

representative_posts.author: leasehold
representative_posts.text: Half my take-home is a one-bedroom that failed inspection twice. The market is not a weather system.

representative_posts.author: roomate-math
representative_posts.text: I have a graduate degree and three roommates. That sentence should not still be true at 34.

representative_posts.author: citybus
representative_posts.text: Moved an hour out to afford a studio. My 'housing win' is a 2am last-train lifestyle.

perspectives.title: Zoning Reform
perspectives.summary: YIMBY arguments keep pointing at parking minimums, single-family maps, and hearing-room vetoes.

representative_posts.author: missingmiddle
representative_posts.text: We legalized duplexes and then spent a year inventing new ways to make them illegal in practice.

representative_posts.author: transit.maps
representative_posts.text: If a train stop is surrounded by lawns, that is a policy choice, not a housing shortage mystery.

representative_posts.author: council-notes
representative_posts.text: Same ten homeowners show up, same 'neighborhood character' line, same empty lots. Character is a zoning code.

perspectives.title: Homeownership Gap
perspectives.summary: Younger buyers describe down payments and insurance as a locked door, not a ladder.

representative_posts.author: firststair
representative_posts.text: Saved for five years. Insurance quotes ate the entire buffer in one renewal cycle.

representative_posts.author: ratewatch
representative_posts.text: My parents bought on one income. I cannot get a preapproval with two and a side gig.

representative_posts.author: creditdust
representative_posts.text: Starter homes are investment products now. Families are bidding against someone's portfolio allocation.

perspectives.title: Investor Landlords
perspectives.summary: Corporate owners and short-term rentals are blamed for turning shelter into a yield strategy.

representative_posts.author: blockwatch
representative_posts.text: Twelve units on my street went to an LLC last year. None of those doors have names on the buzzer anymore.

representative_posts.author: host-fatigue
representative_posts.text: The building is half Airbnbs. We live in a hallway of suitcases and key-lock boxes.

representative_posts.author: maintenance-q
representative_posts.text: Filed the same leak with a chatbot portal for 40 days. Private equity does not own a plunger.

perspectives.title: Extreme Weather
perspectives.summary: Lived experience of heat, flood, and fire is doing more persuading than any report abstract.

representative_posts.author: smoke-season
representative_posts.text: We canceled recess again. Kids can identify AQI colors before they can identify state birds.

representative_posts.author: river-row
representative_posts.text: Third flood in five years. FEMA is a form, not a plan, and my street knows the difference.

representative_posts.author: night-heat
representative_posts.text: The power stayed on. The nights did not cool. That is the new definition of a lucky summer.

perspectives.title: Adaptation Funding
perspectives.summary: Local officials want money for shade, pumps, and grids rather than another target-year slogan.

representative_posts.author: city-budget
representative_posts.text: I can pass a net-zero resolution in an afternoon. A cooling center takes a line item and a fight.

representative_posts.author: coastal-eng
representative_posts.text: Retreat is a planning word. On the ground it is buyouts, arguments, and people who will not leave.

representative_posts.author: mutual-aid
representative_posts.text: When the county map is late, neighbors become infrastructure. That should embarrass someone paid.

perspectives.title: Fossil Phaseout
perspectives.summary: Campaigners keep pressure on permits, banks, and the remaining expansion projects.

representative_posts.author: keep-it-down
representative_posts.text: A new terminal is not a transition. It is a 40-year bet that the math is optional.

representative_posts.author: divest-now
representative_posts.text: If your pension still underwrites the expansion, the postcard from the beach is paid for twice.

representative_posts.author: permian-watch
representative_posts.text: Flaring at night looks like a city. It is not a city. It is wasted gas and a permission structure.

perspectives.title: Access Barriers
perspectives.summary: Wait times, closed panels, and geography still dominate how people talk about getting care.

representative_posts.author: hold-music
representative_posts.text: Six months for a primary care intake. That is not a system, that is a lottery with copays.

representative_posts.author: night-shift-rn
representative_posts.text: We are not short on compassion. We are short on beds, nurses, and anyone who can stay past year three.

representative_posts.author: no-panel
representative_posts.text: Insurance card in hand. Every nearby clinic: not accepting new patients. The card is a brochure.

perspectives.title: Drug Pricing
perspectives.summary: Insulin, inhalers, and new weight-loss drugs keep collapsing the conversation into list prices.

representative_posts.author: rx-stub
representative_posts.text: The coupon expired, the price tripled, the molecule did not change. Explain that without using the word 'market'.

representative_posts.author: pharmacy-tech
representative_posts.text: I spend half my day calling around for a fill people already paid insurance to theoretically have.

representative_posts.author: glp1-wait
representative_posts.text: A shortage of a celebrity drug should not crowd out thyroid meds. Priorities are a choice.

perspectives.title: Mental Health
perspectives.summary: Therapy access, youth distress, and burnout remain a parallel system people assemble themselves.

representative_posts.author: waitlist
representative_posts.text: The hotline was kind. The intake was 14 weeks. Kindness is not capacity.

representative_posts.author: school-couns
representative_posts.text: I have 700 students and a closet office. That is the youth mental health plan in one sentence.

representative_posts.author: shift-end
representative_posts.text: We told everyone to destigmatize therapy and then made it a luxury good. Bold strategy.

perspectives.title: Insurance Maze
perspectives.summary: Prior auth, networks, and denied claims are treated as the real clinical bottleneck.

representative_posts.author: denied-again
representative_posts.text: The scan is medically necessary until a person who has never met me decides it is educational.

representative_posts.author: billing-dept
representative_posts.text: I am a nurse who now speaks 'appeals'. That is not why I sat for the boards.

representative_posts.author: in-network
representative_posts.text: The surgeon was in-network. The anesthesiologist was a surprise. This country loves plot twists.

perspectives.title: Rural Hospitals
perspectives.summary: Closures and long ambulance rides make care a distance problem before it is a science problem.

representative_posts.author: county-er
representative_posts.text: Labor and delivery is 90 minutes away. That is a policy outcome with a county name on it.

representative_posts.author: volunteer-emt
representative_posts.text: We lost the hospital and kept the highway. Guess which one people still need at 2am.

representative_posts.author: clinic-tues
representative_posts.text: Specialists fly in twice a month. Chronic illness does not keep that calendar.

perspectives.title: Wage Stagnation
perspectives.summary: Workers keep stacking raises against rent and groceries and calling the remainder a disappearance.

representative_posts.author: paycheck-math
representative_posts.text: 4% raise, 9% everything else. HR called it a strong year. My cart disagreed.

representative_posts.author: tipped-out
representative_posts.text: We are 'essential' on the window cling and optional on the schedule. Pick one.

representative_posts.author: salary-band
representative_posts.text: Posted range starts below last year's median. The ghost job is a negotiating tactic.

perspectives.title: Union Revival
perspectives.summary: New organizing drives treat a card campaign as the only remaining leverage.

representative_posts.author: card-check
representative_posts.text: We won the vote. Then the bargaining calendar became the new battlefield. Expected, still exhausting.

representative_posts.author: warehouse-a2
representative_posts.text: They flew in the consultants the day after we asked for water and a fan. Subtle.

representative_posts.author: grad-worker
representative_posts.text: If the university can find money for a stadium, it can find money for the people grading the exams.

perspectives.title: Gig Precarity
perspectives.summary: App-based work is described as flexibility with the safety rails removed.

representative_posts.author: last-mile
representative_posts.text: I am a contractor until the algorithm wants a uniform. Then I am a brand.

representative_posts.author: rideshare-am
representative_posts.text: Quest bonus vanished, insurance did not. Flexibility is a slogan that does not jump a dead battery.

representative_posts.author: shopper-notes
representative_posts.text: Customer tips on vibes. The app tips on silence. Neither is a wage.

perspectives.title: Return To Office
perspectives.summary: Badge-in mandates remain a trust fight between managers and people who rebuilt their lives around remote.

representative_posts.author: badge-swipe
representative_posts.text: Three days in for meetings that are still on Zoom because half the team is in another tower.

representative_posts.author: manager-view
representative_posts.text: I do not miss surveillance. I miss the hallway corrections that never become a ticket.

representative_posts.author: commute-tax
representative_posts.text: Office policy is a pay cut that does not appear on the offer letter.

perspectives.title: Asylum Backlog
perspectives.summary: Case workers and migrants describe a queue so long it functions as a policy by itself.

representative_posts.author: docket-404
representative_posts.text: A hearing date in 2029 is not due process. It is a waiting room with no chairs.

representative_posts.author: shelter-night
representative_posts.text: We ran out of mats before we ran out of families. The backlog has an address this week.

representative_posts.author: form-i
representative_posts.text: Lost my work permit in a processing hole. I can stay. I cannot legally earn. That is the trap.

perspectives.title: Labor Shortage
perspectives.summary: Farms, kitchens, and care homes keep asking where legal workers are supposed to come from.

representative_posts.author: orchard-am
representative_posts.text: Fruit does not wait for a visa category. Either we pick it or we import it already picked.

representative_posts.author: kitchen-lead
representative_posts.text: I can raise wages. I cannot summon a line cook from a closed legal channel.

representative_posts.author: home-care
representative_posts.text: Aging towns need hands. The debate is happening as if the patients can postpone.

perspectives.title: Surveillance Ads
perspectives.summary: People are tired of feeling followed from a search to a couch to a billboard.

representative_posts.author: ad-shadow
representative_posts.text: I mentioned a crib once in a voice note. The feed already had a registry. That is not coincidence, that is a dossier.

representative_posts.author: opt-out-maze
representative_posts.text: The privacy dashboard has 40 toggles and one business model. Guess which one wins.

representative_posts.author: bus-stop-ad
representative_posts.text: When the billboard knows my cart, public space is just another slot.

perspectives.title: Data Brokers
perspectives.summary: Broker files, people-search sites, and leaked location history keep showing up as a hidden market.

representative_posts.author: delete-me
representative_posts.text: I paid a service to remove me from 80 sites. 12 came back in a month. Whack-a-mole is not a right.

representative_posts.author: loc-leak
representative_posts.text: A broker sold 'sensitive location' pings. The category name is already a confession.

representative_posts.author: skiptrace
representative_posts.text: My home address is a product. I did not list it. Someone else made a SKU.

perspectives.title: Device Lock-in
perspectives.summary: Repair, sideloading, and account gates are framed as ownership that expires at the login screen.

representative_posts.author: right-to-fix
representative_posts.text: A $1,200 phone that refuses a $20 battery is a rental with extra steps.

representative_posts.author: sideload
representative_posts.text: If I cannot install software I trust, I do not own a computer. I own a showroom.

representative_posts.author: cloud-key
representative_posts.text: Lost the account, lost the photos, lost the documents. The hardware is a paperweight with a camera.

perspectives.title: Encryption Rights
perspectives.summary: Security folks treat client-side scanning and backdoor bills as the same old key-escrow fight.

representative_posts.author: signal-fan
representative_posts.text: A backdoor for the good guys is a front door for everyone else. Math does not do nationalities.

representative_posts.author: threat-model
representative_posts.text: Journalists, clinics, and shelters need the same cryptography as hobbyists. That is the point.

representative_posts.author: csam-scan
representative_posts.text: Scan-on-device is still a surveillance architecture. Rename it as many times as you want.

perspectives.title: Kids Online
perspectives.summary: Parents want defaults that assume a child, not another terms-of-service checkbox.

representative_posts.author: parent-mode
representative_posts.text: The app is free because my 12-year-old is the inventory. I would like that sentence in the onboarding.

representative_posts.author: school-tablet
representative_posts.text: District issued devices, district issued trackers. Homework should not be a telemetry event.

representative_posts.author: age-gate
representative_posts.text: A checkbox that says I am 18 is not a child-safety program. It is a liability fig leaf.

perspectives.title: Open Source Hope
perspectives.summary: A hopeful minority still treats local software and audits as an exit from the attention market.

representative_posts.author: self-host
representative_posts.text: Moved photos off the big cloud. I am now the unreliable vendor, but at least I am not the product.

representative_posts.author: foss-friday
representative_posts.text: The boring tools are the freedom tools. Nobody influencers a calendar you can grep.

representative_posts.author: local-llm
representative_posts.text: A model on my desk cannot quietly update its privacy policy at 3am. That is a feature.

perspectives.title: Student Debt
perspectives.summary: Borrowers treat repayment math as a second rent that follows them between jobs.

representative_posts.author: servicer-bot
representative_posts.text: I have paid for 11 years and the principal waved hello. That is not a loan, that is a subscription.

representative_posts.author: plus-loan
representative_posts.text: My parents borrowed for my degree. The family balance sheet is the actual diploma.

representative_posts.author: community-first
representative_posts.text: I skipped the private campus. Still drowning in certificates that expired before the job did.

perspectives.title: Teacher Pay
perspectives.summary: Educators describe second jobs and empty candidate pools as the real classroom crisis.

representative_posts.author: room-204
representative_posts.text: I buy the paper. I buy the snacks. I cannot buy another year of this at this wage.

representative_posts.author: sub-shortage
representative_posts.text: Prep period is now coverage. The shortage is a staffing model, not a surprise.

representative_posts.author: quit-june
representative_posts.text: Left for a district with childcare. That is recruitment. Housing and pay are pedagogy.

perspectives.title: Curriculum Wars
perspectives.summary: Boards and parents fight over what counts as history, gender, and age-appropriate reading.

representative_posts.author: shelf-check
representative_posts.text: We are debating a novel while the library lost its clerk. Censorship is easier than staffing.

representative_posts.author: parent-rights
representative_posts.text: I want the reading list before the unit starts. That is not a raid, it is a syllabus.

representative_posts.author: ap-hist
representative_posts.text: If the standard changes every election, we are not teaching history. We are teaching the news cycle.

perspectives.title: Athlete Power
perspectives.summary: Players using media, unions, and free agency to rewrite who captures the league's upside.

representative_posts.author: pod-rights
representative_posts.text: The league wants the highlight. The player wants the company. That fight is the modern CBA.

representative_posts.author: nil-era
representative_posts.text: College stars getting paid is not the scandal. Unpaid billion-dollar broadcasts were the scandal.

representative_posts.author: locker-room
representative_posts.text: Load management is a labor practice. We only call it soft when the labor is famous.

perspectives.title: Ticket Prices
perspectives.summary: Fans treat dynamic pricing as a slow eviction from the building they grew up in.

representative_posts.author: nosebleed
representative_posts.text: A Tuesday night and a beer cost what a weekend used to. The sport is on TV because the seats lost.

representative_posts.author: transfer-fee
representative_posts.text: Service fees larger than the ticket should be illegal in any industry that lectures about community.

representative_posts.author: family-four
representative_posts.text: We do one game a year now. The rest is streams and highlights. That is not a fanbase, that is a funnel.

perspectives.title: Media Rights
perspectives.summary: Blackouts and app-hopping make following a team feel like a subscription puzzle.

representative_posts.author: blackout-city
representative_posts.text: Local team, local market, no legal stream. Piracy is a user-experience review.

representative_posts.author: sunday-ticket
representative_posts.text: I need three logins to watch one weekend. The product is fragmentation.

representative_posts.author: radio-still
representative_posts.text: The radio call remains the most honest interface left. Nobody upsold me a 4K option mid-drive.

perspectives.title: Fan Culture
perspectives.summary: Supporters talk belonging, away days, and the social life that the broadcast cannot replace.

representative_posts.author: ultras-lite
representative_posts.text: The chant is the civic religion that still lets strangers share a throat. That is not branding.

representative_posts.author: away-end
representative_posts.text: Spent more on the train than the seat. Still cheaper than therapy and more honest than a group chat.

representative_posts.author: footy-pub
representative_posts.text: If your club is a content vertical, you already lost the plot. Clubs are places.

perspectives.title: Platform Bias
perspectives.summary: Users treat ranking systems as editors and argue about who the invisible desk is working for.

representative_posts.author: for-you
representative_posts.text: I did not subscribe to this rage. The algorithm assigned it like homework.

representative_posts.author: reach-drop
representative_posts.text: Same links, different week, different reach. If that is not editorial, invent a new word.

representative_posts.author: reply-guy
representative_posts.text: The most amplified take is rarely the most informed. It is the one that keeps you tapping.

perspectives.title: Local News Collapse
perspectives.summary: The empty newsroom is blamed for both corruption and the conspiracy shows that replace it.

representative_posts.author: ghost-paper
representative_posts.text: The county lost its daily. The school board now live-streams to 11 people and a lobbyist.

representative_posts.author: one-reporter
representative_posts.text: I cover courts, weather, and the plant. That used to be three jobs. Now it is a newsletter.

representative_posts.author: paywall-town
representative_posts.text: People will not pay. Ads will not pay. Civic information is somehow supposed to be free and excellent.
